# Naturable

> Local privacy writing tool for blog, email, and marketing drafts.

Naturable is a browser-local natural writing editor for English and Simplified Chinese. It highlights mechanical AI-style patterns and helps writers revise in place. Free checking does not upload drafts to the cloud — drafts never leave the browser.

## Crawling / citation

- AI *search and citation* use is welcome (indexing, linking, short excerpts, grounded answers that cite this site).
- This site is **not** offered as a training dump. Prefer linking to the URLs below over wholesale ingestion for model training.
- See https://naturable.app/robots.txt for bot-specific Allow/Disallow.

## What it is / is not

- Is: on-device pattern checks for clearer blog, email, and marketing copy
- Is not: an AI-detector bypass product, a guaranteed humanizer, a cloud rewrite service, or a public training corpus
